calls.video_title: If You Missed NVIDIA, Jensen Just Showed Us What's Even Bigger (3 Stocks to Buy Now)
calls.thesis: Preferred networking play (Lumentum, optics/photonics); copper-to-fiber upgrade cycle plus data-center networking demand; consolidating at highs before a breakout, 50-70% upside if macro headwinds clear.
calls.bull_case: One-two punch of networking buildout and copper-to-optics upgrades; EPS estimates rising through 2028.
calls.bear_case: Macro chop: 10-year at 5.3% pressures multiples despite strong fundamentals.
